# Commands

<!-- Generated by `mise run docs:commands`: this intro from docs/commands-intro.md, the list from the task
descriptions in tasks/*.toml and mise.toml. Edit those, not this file. -->

Every command is a mise task: `mise run <task>`; `mise tasks` lists them. Which to use when:

- **Develop:** `dev:native` for UI and text (plain Go, seconds per save); `dev` for the real Worker runtime (board,
  D1, Durable Objects, the server's Intl) with the fast `build:dev`.
- **Build:** `build` is production (what ships and what the tests use), compiled by `WORKER_COMPILER` in mise.toml:
  `tinygo` (smallest wasm, ~1–2 min builds) or `go` (seconds, a bigger wasm). `build:dev` is always standard Go,
  for `dev`.
- **Test:** `check` before pushing (CI runs the same, `ci/check.sh`), then `e2e` for anything in the browser.
  `smoke-remote` runs the smoke checks against the deployed Worker.
- **Ship:** every pushed branch gets a preview and `main` deploys staging, both automatically (Workers Builds).
  Production: `release v1.3` (or a v* tag from GitHub's Releases page) → CI tests it and tags it → Workers Builds
  deploys it, with no Cloudflare credentials anywhere but Cloudflare. `deploy` does it by hand from a machine with fnox credentials.
  All of them go through `ci/deploy.sh`.

## Tasks

### `assets`

- Depends: vendor

- **Usage:** `assets`

Tailwind (gsxui CSS) + assemble dist/site (Static Assets for workerd, go run . and deploy)

### `build`

- Depends: vendor, generate, assets

- **Usage:** `build`

Production build → build/ with WORKER_COMPILER (mise.toml: tinygo or go), size-checked (deploy, staging, CI and the tests use it)

### `build:dev`

- Depends: vendor, generate, assets

- **Usage:** `build:dev`

Dev build → build/: standard Go to wasm, seconds after an edit (mise run dev uses it; never deployed)

### `cf:builds`

- **Usage:** `cf:builds`

Set up Workers Builds for $APP_REPO: every branch deploys (previews; production from the production branch), main deploys staging; idempotent

### `check`

- Depends: test

- **Usage:** `check`

Test the app: TinyGo build + workerd smoke + gsx fmt/gofmt + go vet + go test

### `deploy`

- Depends: test, token-check

- **Usage:** `deploy`

Test, then deploy production → https://$APP_DOMAIN (or $APP_NAME.&lt;subdomain>.workers.dev), then search:audit live

### `dev`

- **Usage:** `dev`

gsx dev → build:dev (standard Go, seconds) + CSS → workerd restart on every .gsx/.go save → http://localhost:8913

### `dev:native`

- Depends: generate, assets

- **Usage:** `dev:native`

gsx dev → go build → native server restart on every save (seconds; no Durable Objects) → http://localhost:9913

### `docs:commands`

- **Usage:** `docs:commands`

Regenerate docs/commands.md from these task descriptions (mise generate task-docs); test:go fails when it's stale

### `e2e`

- Depends: build

- **Usage:** `e2e`

Headless Chrome checks: pages, live board in two browsers, boost ↔ board, presence, Intl, write limit (local workerd, or E2E_BASE=https://…)

### `editor:gsx`

- **Usage:** `editor:gsx`

Install go.mod's gsx into GOPATH/bin for the VS Code gsx language server

### `generate`

- Depends: i18n:messages

- **Usage:** `generate`

go tool gsx generate (after i18n:messages: views call the generated message methods)

### `i18n:generate`

- **Usage:** `i18n:generate`

Regenerate kit/i18n/cldr for I18N_LOCALES from CLDR, via kit/i18n/legacy's generator (network on first run)

### `i18n:legacy`

- **Usage:** `i18n:legacy`

Test kit/i18n/legacy, the earlier server-side Intl implementation (its own module, out of the build)

### `i18n:messages`

- **Usage:** `i18n:messages`

Generate locales/*_msg_gen.go from the UI message catalogs locales/*.toml (I18N_LOCALES, en first)

### `load`

- Depends: build

- **Usage:** `load`

1,000 WebSockets in every locale on one topic + a 50-write burst (local workerd, or LOAD_BASE=https://…)

### `preview`

Test, then deploy a Worker Preview (e.g. pr-7) → its URL on stdout and in .preview-url


- Depends: test

- **Usage:** `preview <name>`

### Arguments
- **`<name>`** — preview name, e.g. pr-7

### `preview:delete`

Delete a Worker Preview (e.g. pr-7) with its Durable Object storage


- **Usage:** `preview:delete <name>`

### Arguments
- **`<name>`** — preview name, e.g. pr-7

### `release`

Release main to production (e.g. v1.3): CI tests it, tags it, Workers Builds deploys it; no Cloudflare credentials needed


- **Usage:** `release <version>`

### Arguments
- **`<version>`** — the release, e.g. v1.3

### `rename`

- **Usage:** `rename`

Make this template yours: mise run rename -- &lt;module path> &lt;app name>  (e.g. github.com/you/board board)

### `run`

- Depends: generate, assets

- **Usage:** `run`

go run . (non-js fallback, dist/site served by Go) → http://localhost:9913

### `search:audit`

Fetch robots.txt and every sitemap URL live as Googlebot: 200, indexable, self-canonical, lang, title, description, one h1, reciprocal hreflang


- **Usage:** `search:audit [--json]`

### Flags
- **`--json`** — JSON on stdout

### `search:google`

- **Usage:** `search:google`

Print links to Google's own reports: site: search, Search Console Pages, Sitemaps, Crawl stats, PageSpeed Insights

### `search:inspect`

One URL: Google's verdict, last crawl and canonical; opens its Search Console page (Test live URL, Request indexing)


- Depends: search:access

- **Usage:** `search:inspect [--json] [--no-open] <page>`

### Arguments
- **`<page>`** — a path like /de/ or a full URL

### Flags
- **`--json`** — JSON on stdout (never opens a browser)
- **`--no-open`** — print Google's link instead of opening it

### `search:setup`

- **Usage:** `search:setup`

One-time: Google Cloud project, Search Console API, service account, key into fnox (needs gcloud auth login)

### `search:sites`

List the Search Console properties the service account can use; fails without Full access


- **Usage:** `search:sites [--json]`

### Flags
- **`--json`** — JSON on stdout

### `search:status`

Search Console: sitemap status and Google's index status for every URL in the sitemap


- Depends: search:access

- **Usage:** `search:status [--json]`

### Flags
- **`--json`** — JSON on stdout

### `search:submit`

- Depends: search:access, search:audit

- **Usage:** `search:submit`

Submit https://$APP_DOMAIN/sitemap.xml to Search Console (after access and a passing live audit)

### `search:todo`

Google's verdict for every sitemap URL (indexed, waiting, duplicate, problem); fails and opens Search Console only for problems


- Depends: search:access

- **Usage:** `search:todo [--json] [--no-open]`

### Flags
- **`--json`** — JSON on stdout (never opens a browser)
- **`--no-open`** — print problem links instead of opening them

### `serve`

- Depends: build

- **Usage:** `serve`

TinyGo build, then workerd with static files first → http://localhost:8913

### `smoke`

- Depends: build

- **Usage:** `smoke`

Run the production build on local workerd and check every route over HTTP (e2e/smoke)

### `smoke-remote`

- **Usage:** `smoke-remote`

The smoke checks (e2e/smoke) against the deployed Worker (.deploy-url, written by deploy)

### `staging`

- Depends: test

- **Usage:** `staging`

Test, then deploy staging: the Worker $APP_NAME-staging → its URL on stdout and in .staging-url

### `tail`

- **Usage:** `tail`

Stream the deployed Worker's live logs (requests, console, exceptions) → Ctrl-C to stop

### `test`

- Depends: smoke, test:go

- **Usage:** `test`

TinyGo build + workerd smoke test + gsx fmt/gofmt check + go vet + kit/ import check + go test

### `test:go`

- Depends: generate

- **Usage:** `test:go`

gsx fmt/gofmt check + go vet + kit/ import check + go test (standard Go; runs beside the TinyGo build)

### `token-check`

- **Usage:** `token-check`

Verify CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (from fnox) against the Cloudflare API

### `upstream:gsxui:css`

- Depends: upstream:gsxui:deps, upstream:gsxui:generate

- **Usage:** `upstream:gsxui:css`

Compile the harness stylesheets with the standalone Tailwind CLI + link fonts

### `upstream:gsxui:deps`

- Depends: upstream:gsxui:fetch

- **Usage:** `upstream:gsxui:deps`

Fetch the lock-pinned packages the harness needs into node_modules (curl, no npm)

### `upstream:gsxui:fetch`

- **Usage:** `upstream:gsxui:fetch`

Check out gsxhq/gsxui at the pinned commit into .upstream/gsxui

### `upstream:gsxui:generate`

- Depends: upstream:gsxui:fetch

- **Usage:** `upstream:gsxui:generate`

go tool gsx generate in the gsxui checkout

### `upstream:gsxui:serve`

- Depends: upstream:gsxui:css

- **Usage:** `upstream:gsxui:serve`

Serve gsxui's full demo via its Go harness → http://127.0.0.1:7799/

### `upstream:gsxui:test`

- Depends: upstream:gsxui:generate, upstream:gsxui:deps

- **Usage:** `upstream:gsxui:test`

gsxui's make test (generate + go vet + go test), Node-free

### `upstream:workers-go:fetch`

- **Usage:** `upstream:workers-go:fetch`

Check out syumai/workers-go v0.36.0 into .upstream/workers-go (read-only source reference)

### `vendor`

- **Usage:** `vendor`

Vendor htmx 4.0.0 htmx.min.js + ext/hx-ws.js + ext/hx-live.js into static/ (curl, integrity-checked)
